commit_message:
fix: items() values agree with __getitem__/values() across projections

iter_items stripped every key field from each value, so with the default
getitem_projection=None items() values lacked _id while store[k] and values()
had it. It now strips only the key fields getitem_projection does not return.

Exclusion getitem projections ({'_id': False}, {'b': False}) were OR-ed into
an inclusion projection by _items_projection, inverting them: items() returned
{} or only the excluded fields. They now stay exclusions; exclusions inside a
key field are applied to the value only, so the key stays whole.

Behaviour change: with getitem_projection=None (the default), items() values
now include the key fields (e.g. _id), as values() always did.
Inclusion projections with expressions or paths inside a key field still go
through projection_union, unchanged.

Adds is_exclusion_projection, projection_returns_field and projection_leaves
to mongodol.util.

Closes #9
